name: mint-mac-care
title: Mint
description: Review AI-tool storage, clean disk space, release memory, uninstall apps, redact files, and undo through Mint
author: dzg-studio

commands.name: mint-status
commands.title: View Mint Status
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: View disk trends, recent activity, and managed folders

commands.name: mint-agents
commands.title: Review AI Agent Storage
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: See what Codex, Claude, Cursor, and other AI tools keep on this Mac

commands.name: mint-scan
commands.title: Free Disk
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: Scan, review, and clean with optional duplicate, similar-photo, and AI archive checks

commands.name: mint-memory
commands.title: Free Memory
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: Review running apps and safely release memory with Mint Boundaries

commands.name: mint-uninstall
commands.title: Uninstall App
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: Find an app and its leftovers, review them, and move selected items to Trash

commands.name: mint-redact
commands.title: Quick Redact
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: Detect sensitive areas locally and save a redacted PDF or image without leaving Raycast

commands.name: mint-full-redact
commands.title: Full Redact in Mint
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: Open a PDF or image in Mint's full visual redaction editor

commands.name: mint-undo
commands.title: Undo Mint Action
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: Restore a recoverable Mint cleanup, uninstall, or file organization action

commands.name: mint-why
commands.title: Explain Disk Growth or File Activity
commands.subtitle: Mint
commands.description: Explain storage growth or investigate Mint operations involving a path

scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'Publish this extension through the Raycast Store, not npm.' && exit 1
